info.title: Coconet Server API
info.description: Local DAG Relay MVP. Devices generate and verify the DAG; the server stores and relays published content. Business payloads are not yet encrypted.

200.description: Server process and Project authority are healthy

Challenge-bound Deployment identity, legacy-compatible protocol version, and independently signed additive capabilities. history_batches_v1 is advertised when semantic projection is configured and covers Bootstrap and subsequent imports.

parameters.name: Origin
parameters.description: Must exactly match the public HTTPS origin, including a non-default port. TLS proxies preserve Host and must be explicitly trusted.

get.description: Validates and consumes OAuth state, browser cookie, PKCE and provider identity. Redirects to Dashboard; no provider credentials enter the browser.

post.description: Pending polling is read-only. Approval and S256 proof are required; a grant can issue only one device credential.
Explicitly join a project by Project ID. Repeated joins are idempotent.

put.description: Replace this account installation's locally saved directory snapshot. Revision makes retries ordered; this does not create project membership.

get.description: Read member-reported folders for this project. Revoked credentials and memberships are excluded. Reports are not real-time device presence.
SSE with committed project revision, reconnect snapshot and access_revoked events. Heartbeats do not read metadata.

200.description: Event stream. graph data is {revision: integer}; access_revoked terminates the stream.
